records.text:
If ROSC is achieved, refer to Post Cardiac Arrest Care (ROSC) protocol.

If ROSC is not achieved, refer to Death and Criteria for Withholding Resuscitation protocol. Contact **Medical Control** for guidance as needed. Note: Once initiated, termination of resuscitative efforts is a **Medical Control** decision only.

records.text:
**Termination of Resuscitation (TOR):**
Contact Medical Control to request TOR if ALL criteria met:
• Arrest was not witnessed by EMS
• After **20 minutes** of continuous CPR with no ROSC
• AND no shocks were delivered

records.text:
**Medical Control Consultation:**
• Contact **Medical Control** for guidance on blood pressure management as needed.
• Do NOT attempt to aggressively lower blood pressure in the field without specific orders.
• Report all associated symptoms, vital signs, and suspected target organ involvement.

records.text:
****CPAP** (Continuous Positive Airway Pressure):**
• **Indications:** Adults with respiratory distress due to pulmonary edema, infection, or near-drowning
• **Initial Settings:** PEEP 5 cmH2O
• **Titration:** Up to 10 cmH2O
• Close monitoring for hypotension or pneumothorax
⚠ **See Pearls for all contraindications**
